title: fix(cli): os serve says once when it cannot write its runtime state file, naming the file and the OS error
body:
Fixes #24091

Clause-②: no

When `os serve` cannot write its runtime state file (`runtime.ENV.PROJECT.json` in `OS_HOME`), it now says so once, on stderr, naming the file and the operating system's own error. The boot still goes on: the file stays best-effort.

## What was wrong

`runtimeBoundPortChannels().writeRuntimeState` in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` ended in `catch { /* non-fatal — supervision file is best-effort */ }` (`:1113` at base `b9ac35cbf`). That catch printed nothing at any level. The doc of `BoundPortChannels.writeRuntimeState` (`:887`) says the file is "the file both of them send a consumer to". So under an uncreatable `OS_HOME` the banner and the IPC message announced a file that was not there, and nothing said why.

## What changed

- `serve.ts`, the `writeRuntimeState` catch: one `console.warn(chalk.yellow(...))` line. It names the file it tried to write, carries the thrown error's own `message` verbatim (for example `ENOTDIR: not a directory, stat 'HOME'`), says the server runs on without the file, and names the remedy (point `OS_HOME` at a writable directory). When the path itself could not be resolved, the line says that instead of a file name. Nothing else in the leg moves: the same `try`, the same write, the same `exit` cleanup.
- The doc of `BoundPortChannels.writeRuntimeState` gains one sentence (best-effort; the real channel says so once), and the doc of `runtimeBoundPortChannels` no longer says the failure handling is "unchanged".
- `packages/cli/test/uncreatable-directory-doors.integration.test.ts`: a seventh concurrent child and three new assertions (below).
- `.changeset/24091-serve-runtime-state-write-warning.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

Landing point: the card's expected one, `writeRuntimeState` itself. It is the producer: the only code that knows the write failed.

## The PM's four mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (the silent catch): confirmed** at `b9ac35cbf`, `serve.ts:1113` as quoted above, and the interface doc at `:887`.
- **H2 (re-measure both inputs at base): confirmed.** Built CLI at `b9ac35cbf`, Node v22.22.0, a scratch project outside the repo with `export default {};`, `OS_DATABASE_URL=:memory:`, `--port 0`, each run in its own process group, killed on the banner tail:

  | `OS_HOME` | base `b9ac35cbf` | this branch (`3770601b3`) |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | `/proc/os-24091-x` | `Press Ctrl+C to stop` at 2.9 s; 0 lines name the state file or an error code | banner tail at 3.1 s; 1 line: `⚠ Runtime state file not written: /proc/os-24091-fix/runtime.env_local.proj-4d4278c111ec.json — ENOENT: no such file or directory, mkdir '/proc/os-24091-fix'. The server runs on …` |
  | `SCRATCH/afile/sub`, `afile` a regular file | banner tail at 3.2 s; 0 such lines | banner tail at 3.0 s; 1 line: `… runtime.env_local.proj-4d4278c111ec.json — ENOTDIR: not a directory, stat 'SCRATCH/afile/sub'. …` |

  (The base probe's one regex hit in both runs was the plugin-list row `com.objectstack.runtime.default-datasource`, not the state file.) The `/proc` case no longer hangs at base: PR #24088 (`570c7a2d9`) bounded that walk.
- **H3 (the stream): stderr, through `console.warn`**, the channel `serve.ts`'s other boot warnings use (`console.warn(chalk.yellow('  ⚠ …'))`, 26 other sites in the file). `run()` forwards stdout to stderr for the whole process (`redirectStdoutToStderr`, #7915), and `console.warn` writes stderr directly, so the line never reaches the stdio MCP transport's stdout. Measured on both doors above: **0 bytes on stdout**. The line lands among the other `⚠` boot warnings, right above `⚠ Server is ready` / the banner. The quiet window is already closed there (`restoreOutput()` runs before the publish), and it only ever intercepted stdout, `console.log` and `console.debug`.
- **H4 ("says so once"): structurally once.** `writeRuntimeState` is reached only through `publishBoundPort`, and `run()` calls `publishBoundPort` at exactly one site, once per boot. `serve-bound-port-publication.test.ts` already pins that count: the comment-masked source holds exactly two `publishBoundPort(` occurrences, the definition and the one call. There is no rebind path that re-publishes; an `os dev` restart is a new process and a new boot. So no once-guard was added.

## Pin

`packages/cli/test/uncreatable-directory-doors.integration.test.ts`, the file PR #24088 added the serve legs to. It already spawns `bin/run.js` and is already one of `check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`'s thirteen built-entrypoint files, so **the pin did not join that population** and its count label is untouched.

- New leg 7, `serve-notdir`, runs on every platform: `os serve --port 0` under `OS_HOME=WORKDIR/serve-home-file/sub`, where `serve-home-file` is a regular file. It must reach `Press Ctrl+C to stop`, and exactly one output line must name a file under that home with the `runtime.env_local.` prefix, and that line must contain `ENOTDIR`.
- Leg 5 (`/proc`, Linux only): beside the banner it already asserted, exactly one line names the state file, with `ENOENT`.
- Leg 6 (CONTROL, creatable home): no output line names the state file.

Assertions are the named subject (the file's path) and the OS code, never the warning's prose. File wall: 6.29 s for 7 of 7 on the final head (6.30 s before the merge), under the 10 s line.

## Negative control (ablation)

On committed head `3770601b3`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode under the verify lock:

- **Mutation:** anchor `console.warn(chalk.yellow(` plus the next line (x1 → x0) became `String(chalk.yellow(` (x0 → x1), so the line is built and never printed. Blob `1e7eca72a6ad` → `4c06596388ab`.
- **Into `dist/`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` exit 0; `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/cli 'String(chalk.yellow('` exit 0, marker present in 1 built file (absent from `dist/` before the mutation). The pin runs `bin/run.js`, which resolves `dist/`.
- **Result:** 2 failed, 5 passed: leg 5 and leg 7 each `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`. Both banner assertions and the CONTROL legs stayed green, so the boot went on either way and only the line is missing.
- **Restore:** blob after restore == HEAD (`1e7eca72a6ad`), `git diff HEAD` empty. CLI rebuilt exit 0; preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 652 built files, working tree clean. The pin re-ran 7 of 7 green.

## Tests and gates

Exit codes captured before any pipe. Final head `4fd5c3533` (the branch merged with `origin/main` `d3d064447` before this PR opened):

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/cli...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project unit` (the whole unit tier): **exit 0, 310 files, 4,602 tests**, on `4fd5c3533`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project integration test/uncreatable-directory-doors.integration.test.ts`: exit 0, 7 of 7, on `4fd5c3533`. The diff touches this integration file, so it ran here; the rest of the integration tier is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli run typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck`: OK, debt unchanged). The pin file is under `test/`, which `tsconfig.test.json` includes.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --max-warnings=0` over the two changed `.ts` files: exit 0, no output. The repo-wide run is CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 commands on `4fd5c3533`; all 67 ran one by one. 65 exited 0 at once. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: packages with no `dist/` in this worktree); after `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` (75 of 76 cached) both re-ran to exit 0 (`111/69/723/1` entries/packages/cjsFiles/probes above the floors; `OK (14 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`).
  - `--ran` reconciliation: `67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env`: exit 0, 17 spawns of the built CLI, population unchanged. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
  - The derivation warned that `origin/main` had moved one commit past the merge (`6e43b7bc3`), changing only `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`; that one family ran its pre-move copy here, and CI runs the current one.

## Acceptance notes

- The warning is `warn`, not `error`, by AGENTS.md's degradation-level question: the missing file is a functional degradation a supervisor finds out about on its next read, not a durability claim; `check:durability-log-level` does not cover this catch.
- The IPC leg's `catch { /* IPC channel closed — best-effort */ }` stays silent: a closed channel is the ordinary `os serve` case, not a failure.
